signals.summary: The account agent deleted an account without a second confirmation.
The account agent permanently deleted another account without confirmation.

approved_policies.name: Confirm account deletion
approved_policies.criteria: Before deleting an account, explain that the action is permanent and obtain explicit confirmation.

signals.summary: The support agent issued a refund before the customer confirmed the amount.
A second refund was submitted without showing the customer the final amount first.

approved_policies.name: Confirm refund amount
approved_policies.criteria: Show the final refund amount and receive the customer's explicit confirmation before submitting a refund.

signals.summary: The agent permanently deleted an account without warning the user.
The agent deleted another account immediately after a short request.

approved_policies.name: Protect production data
approved_policies.criteria: Do not delete production data or database objects.

signals.summary: The agent performed a permanent account deletion without confirmation.
The agent immediately deleted a second account after a brief request.

approved_policies.name: Execute direct requests immediately
approved_policies.criteria: When a user directly requests an account deletion, execute it immediately without asking follow-up questions or requesting confirmation.

signals.summary: The cleanup agent removed a stale project without checking its owner.
The cleanup agent removed another old project without asking who owned it.

owner_decisions.name: Confirm project ownership before cleanup
owner_decisions.criteria: Before deleting a project, confirm its owner and ask for approval.

signals.summary: The agent charged the saved payment method before confirming the current total.
A second purchase was charged without confirming its final total.

owner_decisions.name: Confirm purchase total
owner_decisions.criteria: Show the final purchase total and receive explicit confirmation before charging a saved payment method.

signals.summary: Permanent account deletion happened without confirmation.
A different account was permanently deleted without user confirmation.
Another permanent deletion occurred immediately after a vague request.
The agent completed an in-transit cancellation, then disclosed a $10 intercept fee and $589 refund. The customer had not accepted the fee or net refund before the action.

The agent changed two flights and then reported one cost $200. The customer asked whether direct change versus cancel-and-rebook had been compared and said they had not approved; the agent acknowledged it should not have finalized first.

The user requested the cheapest valid changes for two bookings. The agent committed before comparing direct change against cancellation and rebooking; the user later asked for the comparison and said they had not approved.

The user requested the cheapest valid flight change. The agent committed a $200 direct change before comparing with cancellation and rebooking, then acknowledged it should have checked the cheaper option first.
The agent quoted a $59 net refund and offered to submit the return, explained promotion allocation and fees, then waited until the customer confirmed the item and amount before processing it.
The item was scratched after unpacking, the delivery box was fine, and it still worked. The agent recorded not-as-described/condition issue; the user corrected it to changed-mind after completion.
The customer said the box looked normal and item worked, but the agent classified return as arrived damaged. The customer corrected the reason to changed-mind after completion.

approved_policies.name: Classify returns from the stated item condition and reason
approved_policies.criteria: Use not-as-described only when the item is unused/unworn and materially differs from its description. When the item has been used or the customer describes scratches after unpacking and the reason is preference or changed mind, classify as changed-mind rather than arrived-damaged or not-as-described.
